answer: The prism lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the lotus is where a second reviewer recomputes them. By the tundra of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, forfeited on duplicate submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
